whoWeAre.title: Know About S&PA
whoWeAre.text: S&PA was founded in 2014 by experienced and talented engineers in the passive fire protection industry. With a commitment to all aspects of quality, our main objective is customer satisfaction. We only provide products recognized worldwide — delivering clear advantages on every project.

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: We design, supply, install and maintain electro-mechanical activities across the following services.
services.service1Desc: We stay updated with the latest methods and techniques in electro-mechanical contracting.
services.service2Desc: We provide the services needed to manage vital places where people work, live, and achieve their goals.
services.service3Desc: Full-fledged ICT and telecom contracting — end-to-end digital infrastructure delivery.
services.service4Desc: Our purpose is to lead facility management by enhancing services, relationships, and profitability.
